divisions.purpose: Coordinate Buddy, specialist routing, approvals, memory, evidence, and system health across the full platform.
divisions.outcome: A single accountable command path from user intent to reviewable work and measured results.
divisions.boundary: CommandCore cannot override consent, professional review, spending approval, or the kill switch.

divisions.purpose: Design and operate model routing, inference, evaluation, compute, storage, and observability infrastructure.
divisions.outcome: Reliable, measurable AI infrastructure that can prefer local and low-cost routes without hiding quality tradeoffs.
divisions.boundary: Model access, weights, licenses, data rights, and production releases require verified evidence.

divisions.purpose: Reduce administrative work through organized scheduling, records, correspondence, and operating procedures.
divisions.outcome: Fewer missed obligations and faster completion of routine administrative work.
divisions.boundary: Buddy prepares and coordinates; identity, signatures, submissions, and account changes require the user.

divisions.purpose: Build, test, govern, and coordinate reusable AI agents and specialist worker teams.
divisions.outcome: Agents with explicit tools, scopes, tests, owners, and failure handling instead of unbounded autonomy.
divisions.boundary: Agents cannot grant themselves permissions, deploy themselves, spend, or bypass review gates.

divisions.purpose: Support farm planning, crop intelligence, livestock operations, equipment use, and agricultural business decisions.
divisions.outcome: Better production decisions, lower waste, and clearer operational evidence.
divisions.boundary: Physical, chemical, veterinary, and regulated decisions remain with qualified people and official guidance.

divisions.purpose: Help creators plan, produce, document, license, present, and sell original visual and performing arts.
divisions.outcome: Professional creative projects with clear provenance, rights, production steps, and audience paths.
divisions.boundary: Real-person likenesses, protected works, and commercial assets require documented rights and consent.

divisions.purpose: Turn repeatable work into observable workflows with connectors, retries, approvals, and rollback paths.
divisions.outcome: Reliable automation that saves time while keeping consequential actions reviewable.
divisions.boundary: No workflow may silently expand scopes, expose credentials, spend, publish, or contact people.

divisions.purpose: Guide founders from validated problem through business setup, offer design, operations, and launch readiness.
divisions.outcome: A documented, testable business launch packet with realistic costs, risks, and next actions.
divisions.boundary: Official registration, legal conclusions, banking, credit, and purchases require the owner and qualified providers.

divisions.purpose: Plan, write, test, debug, secure, document, and ship software through reviewable repository workflows.
divisions.outcome: Working software changes with reproducible tests, clear diffs, rollback, and deployment evidence.
divisions.boundary: Generated code stays in sandboxes or review branches until tests and owner approval pass.

divisions.purpose: Support estimating, scheduling, procurement, documentation, safety planning, and project controls.
divisions.outcome: Construction decisions backed by current scope, cost, schedule, and evidence.
divisions.boundary: Licensed design, permits, inspections, safety authority, and physical work remain human-controlled.

divisions.purpose: Create and manage useful written, visual, audio, and video content across governed production workflows.
divisions.outcome: Audience-ready content with briefs, rights, versions, accessibility, and performance evidence.
divisions.boundary: Content may not impersonate people, misrepresent evidence, violate rights, or publish without approval.

divisions.purpose: Provide education, market analysis, testnet design, custody planning, and risk-aware digital asset tooling.
divisions.outcome: Clear digital-asset decisions with custody boundaries, simulations, and auditable risk disclosures.
divisions.boundary: Buddy never holds private keys, promises returns, mines without authorization, or signs transactions autonomously.

divisions.purpose: Turn consented customer evidence into service improvements, segmentation, retention, and product insight.
divisions.outcome: Explainable customer intelligence that improves service without hidden profiling.
divisions.boundary: Sensitive traits, third-party personal data, and high-impact decisions cannot be inferred or sold.

divisions.purpose: Help owners assess, monitor, harden, and recover their authorized systems with defensive security evidence.
divisions.outcome: Reduced attack surface and better recovery readiness through authorized, non-destructive testing.
divisions.boundary: No unauthorized access, credential attacks, destructive testing, persistence, evasion, or denial of service.

divisions.purpose: Collect, clean, govern, analyze, document, and exchange data with ownership and quality evidence.
divisions.outcome: Trusted data products with provenance, access controls, quality tests, and deletion paths.
divisions.boundary: Credentials, unlawfully obtained data, sensitive profiles, and unlicensed resale packages are blocked.

divisions.purpose: Structure complex decisions using evidence, alternatives, uncertainty, consequences, and accountable review.
divisions.outcome: Better decisions with visible assumptions, tradeoffs, dissent, and follow-up measurements.
divisions.boundary: Buddy supports decisions but does not replace accountable human or licensed professional judgment.

divisions.purpose: Build accessible lessons, courses, practice, tutoring, assessments, and learning simulations.
divisions.outcome: Measurable learning experiences adapted to goals, age, accessibility, and evidence.
divisions.boundary: Minors require protective defaults; grading, credentials, and school decisions remain institution-controlled.

divisions.purpose: Provide portfolio-level strategy, governance, prioritization, and performance visibility across DreamCo systems.
divisions.outcome: A coherent operating portfolio with measurable priorities, budgets, risks, and accountability.
divisions.boundary: Portfolio authority does not bypass division controls, evidence gates, or owner approval.

divisions.purpose: Support enterprise budgeting, planning, treasury analysis, controls, reporting, and financial operations.
divisions.outcome: Auditable financial planning and operating insight with clear assumptions and approvals.
divisions.boundary: Money movement, filings, attestations, and regulated advice require authorized people and systems.

divisions.purpose: Help users understand budgets, cash flow, goals, options, and financial tradeoffs.
divisions.outcome: Clearer financial choices supported by calculations, scenarios, and risk disclosures.
divisions.boundary: Buddy does not guarantee returns, move money, extend credit, or replace licensed advice.

divisions.purpose: Map work from request to completion and coordinate handoffs, queues, dependencies, and approvals.
divisions.outcome: Visible work ownership and predictable completion across people, bots, and systems.
divisions.boundary: Handoffs preserve original permissions and cannot silently authorize downstream actions.

divisions.purpose: Support menu, kitchen, inventory, purchasing, safety, delivery, and food-business operations.
divisions.outcome: Lower waste and stronger service through measurable food operations.
divisions.boundary: Food safety, allergen decisions, inspections, and physical preparation remain qualified human responsibilities.

divisions.purpose: Support lawful international research, localization, trade preparation, culture-aware communication, and expansion.
divisions.outcome: Country-aware plans with sourced legal, cultural, operational, and market assumptions.
divisions.boundary: Local law, sanctions, customs, tax, and professional requirements must be verified before action.

divisions.purpose: Support health education, care preparation, records organization, wellness planning, and provider communication.
divisions.outcome: More prepared health conversations and organized user-controlled information.
divisions.boundary: Buddy does not diagnose, prescribe, provide emergency care, or replace licensed clinicians.

divisions.purpose: Build authentic audiences, partnerships, campaigns, and creator operations with measurable trust.
divisions.outcome: Audience growth based on useful content, transparent relationships, and consented engagement.
divisions.boundary: No fake engagement, deceptive personas, undisclosed endorsements, harassment, or platform evasion.

divisions.purpose: Organize legal information, documents, deadlines, issue spotting, and attorney-ready work packets.
divisions.outcome: Faster legal preparation with sources, jurisdiction labels, and review-ready documents.
divisions.boundary: Buddy is not a lawyer and cannot provide legal representation, final opinions, or unauthorized filings.

divisions.purpose: Help users compare lawful financing options, prepare documentation, understand affordability, and detect risk.
divisions.outcome: Better financing preparation with transparent costs, eligibility assumptions, and alternatives.
divisions.boundary: Buddy does not guarantee approval, falsify eligibility, steer unfairly, or submit without exact approval.

divisions.purpose: Plan preventive maintenance, inspections, work orders, parts, service history, and equipment reliability.
divisions.outcome: Less downtime and safer assets through organized, evidence-based maintenance.
divisions.boundary: Physical work, lockout procedures, safety inspections, and regulated repairs require qualified people.

divisions.purpose: Research markets, competitors, customers, demand, pricing, and product opportunities.
divisions.outcome: Source-backed market choices that separate observations, assumptions, and forecasts.
divisions.boundary: No inside information, deceptive research, fabricated demand, or guaranteed commercial outcomes.

divisions.purpose: Support lawful logistics, readiness, education, maintenance, administration, and veteran resources.
divisions.outcome: Better non-weapon operational readiness and access to verified support resources.
divisions.boundary: Weapons, targeting, surveillance abuse, classified data, and harmful operational guidance are excluded.

divisions.purpose: Improve business operations through process control, capacity planning, service levels, and incident response.
divisions.outcome: Predictable operations with visible constraints, ownership, and recovery procedures.
divisions.boundary: Operational automation cannot override safety controls, workforce rights, contracts, or approval policy.

divisions.purpose: Plan payment acceptance, billing, subscriptions, reconciliation, disputes, and revenue operations.
divisions.outcome: Reliable payment workflows with transparent fees, consent, records, and recovery steps.
divisions.boundary: Buddy never stores raw payment credentials, acts as an unlicensed processor, or moves money without approval.

divisions.purpose: Support user-directed routines, appointments, products, wellness services, and personal-care businesses.
divisions.outcome: More organized personal care with preferences, safety notes, and service planning.
divisions.boundary: Medical claims, invasive procedures, sensitive profiling, and unsafe product guidance are excluded.

divisions.purpose: Support climate, earth observation, sustainability, resilience, and planetary-scale research planning.
divisions.outcome: Evidence-based environmental decisions with uncertainty, provenance, and local context.
divisions.boundary: Scientific claims require source evidence; emergency and public-policy decisions remain accountable to authorities.

divisions.purpose: Operate consulting and professional-service work from discovery through proposal, delivery, and client success.
divisions.outcome: Repeatable client delivery with scoped work, evidence, quality checks, and clear handoffs.
divisions.boundary: Regulated conclusions, contract acceptance, invoicing, and client communications retain accountable approval.

divisions.purpose: Plan and improve manufacturing, production scheduling, quality, materials, throughput, and traceability.
divisions.outcome: Higher throughput and quality with safer, traceable production decisions.
divisions.boundary: Physical controls, machinery, worker safety, and certified quality decisions remain human-controlled.

divisions.purpose: Support personal, property, business, emergency, and continuity protection planning.
divisions.outcome: Prepared users with documented prevention, response, recovery, and escalation paths.
divisions.boundary: No vigilantism, harmful surveillance, weapons guidance, emergency impersonation, or unauthorized monitoring.

divisions.purpose: Support property discovery, underwriting, comparison, due diligence, operations, and transaction preparation.
divisions.outcome: Property decisions with transparent assumptions, local evidence, calculators, and due-diligence steps.
divisions.boundary: No fair-housing violations, guaranteed returns, unlicensed representation, valuation claims, or unauthorized offers.

divisions.purpose: Improve merchandising, inventory, pricing, customer service, commerce operations, and store performance.
divisions.outcome: Better availability, margins, and customer experience through measurable retail workflows.
divisions.boundary: Pricing, personalization, and fraud controls must remain lawful, explainable, and non-discriminatory.

divisions.purpose: Train sales teams and coordinate permission-aware research, qualification, conversations, proposals, and follow-up.
divisions.outcome: Truthful, repeatable sales performance with measurable coaching and respectful customer experiences.
divisions.boundary: No purchased lists, identity deception, spam, hidden recording, pressure tactics, or unapproved outreach.

divisions.purpose: Support literature review, hypothesis design, experiment planning, analysis, reproducibility, and communication.
divisions.outcome: Reproducible scientific work with clear methods, uncertainty, provenance, and peer-review preparation.
divisions.boundary: Buddy cannot fabricate evidence, bypass ethics review, perform unsafe experiments, or claim unverified findings.

divisions.purpose: Plan, create, schedule, moderate, and measure consented social-media and community work.
divisions.outcome: Consistent social presence built on useful content, real identity choices, and audience trust.
divisions.boundary: No account takeover, coordinated manipulation, fake engagement, harassment, or publication without approval.

divisions.purpose: Support lawful sourcing, supplier comparison, trade documentation, logistics, and commercial planning.
divisions.outcome: Traceable trade decisions with supplier, cost, route, compliance, and delivery evidence.
divisions.boundary: Sanctions, customs, restricted goods, contracts, and payments require official verification and approval.

divisions.purpose: Improve routing, fleet planning, dispatch, maintenance, safety, and transportation operations.
divisions.outcome: Safer, more efficient transportation with traceable plans and operating evidence.
divisions.boundary: Driving, dispatch authority, regulated safety decisions, and physical vehicle control remain human-controlled.

divisions.purpose: Design, prototype, test, teach through, and publish original games and interactive simulations.
divisions.outcome: Playable, accessible game experiences with clear design, assets, tests, progression, and release paths.
divisions.boundary: Assets require rights; gambling, child safety, platform rules, payments, and publishing retain strict controls.

divisions.purpose: Research affiliate offers, evaluate partner fit, prepare compliant disclosures and creative tests, track attribution, and reconcile partner reports.
divisions.outcome: Traceable affiliate campaigns with documented offer terms, honest disclosures, measurable creative tests, and reconciled performance.
divisions.boundary: Disclosures must be clear and legally reviewed when needed; no deceptive claims, silent signups, unauthorized account access, or live payouts.

divisions.purpose: Run client-service operations from discovery and scoping through pricing, staffing, delivery, reporting, and renewal planning.
divisions.outcome: Well-scoped, economically sound client engagements with accountable delivery plans and evidence-backed reporting.
divisions.boundary: Client commitments, contracts, sensitive client data, hiring decisions, and external communications require authorized human review.

divisions.purpose: Evaluate model options and design model-development workflows spanning open weights, fine-tuning plans, retrieval systems, evaluation, and model documentation.
divisions.outcome: Reproducible model-development plans with documented tradeoffs, evaluation criteria, data lineage, and release requirements.
divisions.boundary: Model and dataset licenses, training-data rights, compute spend, GPU launches, and production weight promotion require explicit approval and evidence.

divisions.purpose: Help operators evaluate franchise concepts and prepare franchise packages, territory models, royalty scenarios, compliance checklists, and operating playbooks.
divisions.outcome: Reviewable franchise planning packages with transparent assumptions, territory options, unit economics, and operating procedures.
divisions.boundary: Franchise disclosure, registration, contracts, securities, and legal compliance require qualified counsel and official review; calculations are planning estimates.

divisions.purpose: Design and validate reliable integrations across APIs, webhooks, authentication scopes, idempotency controls, and operational runbooks.
divisions.outcome: Secure, observable, retry-safe integrations with documented contracts, test evidence, and rollback procedures.
divisions.boundary: Production credentials, permission grants, external writes, and production endpoint changes require least-privilege configuration and owner approval.

divisions.purpose: Organize software, media, brand, and product-rights decisions through license research, rights matrices, royalty models, renewal tracking, and counsel-ready drafts.
divisions.outcome: Traceable rights and licensing records with clear obligations, renewal dates, royalty assumptions, and escalation points.
divisions.boundary: License interpretation, takedown notices, infringement claims, and legal conclusions require qualified counsel; no rights are assumed from availability.

divisions.purpose: Plan robotics tasks and components through simulation scenarios, safety envelopes, parts lists, and structured field logs.
divisions.outcome: Testable robotics plans with explicit operating envelopes, component traceability, simulation evidence, and field feedback.
divisions.boundary: No unsupervised physical actuation, safety interlock changes, hazardous operation, or deployment to live hardware without qualified human authorization.

divisions.purpose: Develop SaaS concepts and operating plans across customer goals, product packaging, pricing, onboarding, retention, and service communications.
divisions.outcome: A measurable SaaS operating plan connecting customer value, pricing assumptions, activation, retention, and service reliability.
divisions.boundary: Pricing changes, customer messaging, production deployments, billing actions, and access to customer data require authorization and review.

divisions.purpose: Plan and improve streaming channels through editorial calendars, thumbnail briefs, scripts, premiere checklists, and audience feedback analysis.
divisions.outcome: Consistent, audience-aware streaming production with clear creative briefs, rights checks, release readiness, and performance learning.
divisions.boundary: No fake engagement, impersonation, unauthorized use of copyrighted material, or publishing and account actions without creator approval.

divisions.purpose: Prepare practical travel plans with itineraries, visa-document checklists, trip budgets, vendor comparisons, and offline-ready travel packs.
divisions.outcome: Clear, budget-aware travel plans with source links, document reminders, contingency options, and offline access to essential trip information.
divisions.boundary: Visa and entry rules must be checked with official authorities; no legal guarantees, bookings, purchases, or itinerary changes without user confirmation.
